reasonableness.revised_prompt: 1:1 soft-plastic Royal Match expression variant. LOCK camera and staging exactly like the identity pad: low-angle view, chubby King peeking bottom-left behind blue/purple pillar topped with gold sphere, slim butler on the right holding yellow-white parasol and white cloth, purple-roof cream castle and green hedge behind, teal sky with soft clouds. LOCK identity: gold crown with red diamond gem, grey-white beard and brows, large round nose, blue-yellow royal tunic stripes, butler red coat and grey mustache unchanged. ONLY named delta (only_named_delta): change the KING expression to a playful wink — his RIGHT eye (viewer left) fully closed with upper eyelid pressed shut covering the iris, LEFT eye open with blue iris + highlight, slight raised cheek on wink side, small cheeky smile showing upper teeth; butler expression and pose unchanged. Do not change costume, crown shape, beard silhouette, camera, pillar, castle, parasol, aspect, or medium. Soft plastic commercial CGI, soft upper-right daylight. Fail-at-glance: both eyes open, both eyes closed, solo portrait reframe, missing butler, or new wardrobe = fail.
